messages:
Maria H.: Quick weekly readout attached — flagged two clusters with growing tilt. main notes below, please react with :thumbsup: when you’ve reviewed.

Maria H.: Key points — eu-west1 shows sustained 85%+ gpu utilization on batch workloads, us-west2 trending up because of marketing campaign, apac-sg underutilized. Preemptible churn in us-west2 spiking this morning (logs below).

Kevin L.: ack. do we have projected gpu-hours for next 7 days?

Maria H.: Short table in the thread:
```
Cluster   | GPUs | util% | est_hours/day
eu-west1  | 32   | 85%   | 672
us-west2  | 48   | 78%   | 936
apac-sg   | 16   | 42%   | 192
```

Maria H.: Projection notes — if marketing campaign sustains +20% traffic, us-west2 will need +12 GPUs (preferred: add 8 preemptible + 4 reserved). eu-west1 needs runway: recommend shifting 6 GPUs from apac-sg for 72h then re-evaluate.

Thomas R.: re: shift — network egress for eu-west1 -> apac wouldn't change but moving training jobs might. any objection to cold-migrate non-critical batches?

Anya P.: I'll queue a canary cold-migrate of a small batch job at 2130 UTC. tagging @Kevin L. to watch costs.

Kevin L.: watching. can we limit auto-scale to avoid overprovisioning when preemptibles drop? current policy spikes +50% on backfill. maybe set cap at +25% for 6h.

Infra Ops: noted. changing ASG cap for us-west2 from +50% to +25% for the next 12 hours. will revert after review. (reacted :eyes:)

SRE Bot: Preemptible churn alert: 2026-11-12T07:18:12Z - us-west2 - 18% preemptible loss over 15m window. Average reclaim time 67s.

Maria H.: ops — once cap applied, can you also attach the short-run cost delta for shifting 6 GPUs EU->APAC? rough ballpark is fine.

Infra Ops: rough delta: shifting 6 V100 equiv from apac-sg to eu-west1 increases hourly cost by ~ $4.8/hr (network egress negligible for these internal jobs). Will post detailed numbers in the doc.

Kevin L.: if marketing drops, we should flip back quickly. propose a simple policy: prefer preemptible fill first, reserved only when sustained 6h above 80% per-cluster.

Maria H.: agreed. action items: 1) Anya to run canary migrate (2130 UTC). 2) Infra Ops to update ASG cap (done) and post cost deltas in doc. 3) Thomas to validate job affinity rules for quick rollback. 4) Kevin to draft 6h sustained policy.

Anya P.: canary started at 2130 UTC — logs look clean so far, initial job completed in 14m.

Thomas R.: checked affinity rules, can rollback via tag flip within ~4m.

Kevin L.: drafting policy now, will drop PR to infra-runbooks by EOD.

Maria H.: thanks all. I'll compile this into the weekly capacity note and include a short runbook snippet for the migration path. (reacted :thumbsup:)

Infra Ops: leaving this thread open for incident escalation; will post final numbers in ~2h.
